1670509847534551040.a: Notice how the one in the photo background is really short? That's because it is tuned to ultrasonic frequencies. It can pickup the whine of electronics and glass breaking and other things without overwhelming the microphone amp with ambient sounds like people and dogs and such.

1670510266457489408.a: Each tube is tuned to exactly one audio frequency. You just add one tube for each frequency you need to record at a distance. The one at Cyberia had a mixing chamber at the backside that allowed a large, like 3 inch, dynamic mic element to capture the audio from each tube at once
